findings.quote: Your dentist will tell you what to avoid while the area heals, and vaping is worth raising at your visit.
findings.why: The post gives no reason and no concrete guidance on vaping during healing, although mainstream dental guidance says nicotine use, including vaping, can slow healing after procedures.
findings.fix: Add one sentence stating that smoking and nicotine use, including vaping, can slow healing and that the patient should follow the dentist's specific aftercare instructions.
